info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Institution Login Management API
info.description: The Institution Login Management API provides functionality to manage user credentials associated with different institutions. This API allows for the deletion of specific institution logins tied to a customer, which is essential for maintaining accurate user access and security measures. Typical consumers of this API include administrative users and systems responsible for user account management and security compliance. By offering streamlined access to login management, organizations can enhance their ability to handle user credentials effectively.

delete.summary: Remove an institution login associated with the customer.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete an institution login for a specific customer by referencing the customer ID and the institution login ID. Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to delete a specific institution login associated with the customer CUST-100045. The associated institution login is identified by RES-100045. Ensure that you provide the necessary details as defined in the schema.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content.

DeleteCustomerInstitutionLoginRes100045R.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting an institution login associated with a specific customer.

DeleteCustomerInstitutionLoginRes100045R.title: Delete Institution Logins Response
DeleteCustomerInstitutionLoginRes100045R.description: The response schema for a successful deletion of institution logins with a 204 status code.
